2609.28416.title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
2609.28416.paper_summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from \emph{task-state contamination}, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort subsequent decisions. We propose the \textbf{Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM)}, which models how reasoning and actions shape future task progress rather than simulating tool responses. AEWM combines \textbf{Action Judge} to distinguish \textsc{Critical}, \textsc{Exploratory}, and \textsc{Noisy} decisions with \textbf{State Revision} to edit noisy reasoning--action continuations from the same observed history. \textbf{EditAct} integrates these capabilities with real execution, directly changing the state underlying subsequent decisions rather than merely providing critiques. We train AEWM across Search, Terminal, and Software Engineering through mid-training and supervised fine-tuning. AEWM achieves 70.5\% macro-F1 on our Action Judge benchmark, exceeding the strongest frontier baseline by 10.6 points. Across six benchmarks and three agent backbones, EditAct improves average scores by 3.2--6.7 points over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, rejection sampling fine-tuning on verified EditAct trajectories, termed \textbf{AEWM-RFT}, improves over Self-RFT by 2.2--2.6 points across three domains without online AEWM guidance.
2609.28416.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展使得代理能夠在多樣化的環境中處理長期任務。為了進一步提高代理的表現，現有的語言世界模型通常預測環境觀察，然而在有真實反饋的情況下，重建高熵、執行依賴的工具回應的價值有限。與此同時，代理遭受\emph{任務狀態污染}，即不支持的假設和過時的計劃持續存在於歷史中，並扭曲後續的決策。我們提出了\textbf{代理編輯世界模型（AEWM）}，該模型模擬推理和行動如何塑造未來的任務進展，而不是模擬工具回應。AEWM結合了\textbf{行動判斷器}來區分\textsc{關鍵}、\textsc{探索性}和\textsc{噪聲}決策，以及\textbf{狀態修訂}來編輯來自相同觀察歷史的噪聲推理-行動延續。\textbf{EditAct}將這些能力與實際執行整合，直接改變後續決策所依賴的狀態，而不僅僅是提供批評。我們通過中期訓練和監督微調在搜尋、終端和軟體工程上訓練AEWM。AEWM在我們的行動判斷基準上達到了70.5\%的宏觀F1，超過了最強前沿基準10.6個點。在六個基準和三個代理骨幹上，EditAct的平均得分比最強基準提高了3.2至6.7個點。此外，對經過驗證的EditAct軌跡進行拒絕抽樣微調，稱為\textbf{AEWM-RFT}，在三個領域中相比Self-RFT提高了2.2至2.6個點，且無需在線AEWM指導。
